<h1>Chord Options (Root / Scale / CP Toggle)</h1>

## Purpose

The global tonal-centre control: sets the **root note** and **scale**
(major/minor) used by every chord-following sequencer, hosts the per-mode
chord-adjustment tweaks, and the per-sequencer **CP-follow toggle** that
decides which sequencers track the chord progression at all.

## Interaction

Three bands on the shared view:

- **Row 8, chord-root strip**: 12 cells (LHS cols 1–8 = roots 0–7, RHS
  cols 1–4 = roots 8–11). Selected root is bright; others dim.
- **RHS rows 7–8, cols 7–8, the scale region**: row 8 selects major/minor;
  row 7 toggles the major/minor chord-adjustment flags.
- **Row 1, the CP toggle**: one cell per chord-following sequencer (LHS cols
  1–7 = sequencers 1–7, RHS cols 1–7 = sequencers 9–15). Off = slate grey, on = the
  sequencer's own colour.

## Shortcuts

### LHS / shared strip: root + CP toggle

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row 8 root cell | LP grid | Set the global root note (0–11) | none |
| Press row 1 sequencer cell | LP grid | Toggle that sequencer's chord-progression follow on/off | none |

### RHS: scale / chord adjustment

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row 8, col 7 / col 8 | LP RHS | Select **major** / **minor** scale; broadcasts to every scale-aware view immediately | none |
| Press row 7, col 7 / col 8 | LP RHS | Cycle the major / minor chord-adjustment mode: plain → adjusted → diatonic → plain. The two qualities are set independently | none |

### Whole-view behaviour

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO | LP grid | **No-op**: deliberately excluded from reset/randomise | any |

> A scale-mode change instantly re-voices all chord-following sequencers
> and re-draws note-arp keyboard overlays.
